title: Showing Gratitude Beyond Words
paragraphs: Setelah seorang rekan kerja menanggung tanggung jawabnya selama dua minggu penuh saat keadaan darurat keluarga, Danish merasa bahwa ucapan terima kasih verbal sederhana saja tidak akan cukup menyampaikan betapa signifikannya pengorbanan itu baginya.

Alih-alih hanya mengandalkan kata-kata, ia mengatur untuk mengambil alih proyek sulit yang selama ini dihindari rekan kerjanya, gestur praktis yang menunjukkan rasa terima kasihnya melalui tindakan, bukan hanya melalui pernyataan.
Rekan kerjanya awalnya bersikeras ini tidak perlu, menyebutkan bahwa membantu selama keadaan darurat sekadar diharapkan antar rekan tim yang benar-benar peduli satu sama lain.

Danish tetap bersikukuh dengan lembut, menjelaskan bahwa membalas melalui tindakan, bukan hanya kata-kata, terasa sebagai cara yang lebih jujur dan lengkap untuk mengakui apa arti pengorbanan rekan kerjanya baginya.
answerKey: After a colleague covered his responsibilities for two full weeks during a family emergency, Danish felt that a simple verbal thank you would not adequately convey how significant the sacrifice had genuinely been for him. Rather than relying solely on words, he arranged to take over a difficult project his colleague had been dreading, a practical gesture that demonstrated his gratitude through action rather than through statements alone. His colleague initially insisted this was unnecessary, mentioning that helping during an emergency was simply expected between teammates who genuinely cared about one another's wellbeing. Danish persisted gently, explaining that reciprocating through action, rather than only words, felt like a more honest and complete way to acknowledge what his colleague's sacrifice had actually meant to him.
